name: Sith Destroyer
description: A Sith Destroyer was a capital ship used by the Sith during the New Sith Wars. The ship type was armed with at least a broadside laser cannon artillery and could overpower several battleships. One such vessel was the Nightfall, Lord Kaan's flagship. It led a fleet of Corsair battleships and Sith Dreadnaughts in the First Battle of Ruusan.
